profile_headline: Data Scientist at Deloitte | Authoring a Deep learning Book | Tech Speaker| Open Source Contributor
post_content:
It's pretty unfortunate that hardly any data science course, any LinkedIn Data
Science "Influencer" talks about the practical advice for Data Science. Data
Science in the industry is highly different than what you see on LinkedIn
videos, posts. Data science is much much more than pd.read_csv() - it only
works well at the tutorials. Industry data is much heavier and require
parallel processing, big data and whatnot. We need to explore the data with
complex approaches not just excel sheets. We need to worry about code
optimisation as well when we are making production level systems with huge
volumes of data. Budding data scientists, please understand the computer
vision videos on Linkedin are all good to attract the likes but in real-world
its totally different, you get all the bad possible data with so many issues.
Bottom line: Build relevant skills required by the industry, these videos/30
days courses come and go. hashtag#dataScience hashtag#Advice hashtag#Industry
hashtag#practical
